tools.name: ask_hirepulse_advisor
tools.description: Free advisor that maps a goal (B2B leads, hiring signals, buying intent, tech stack, Google Ads, due diligence) to the matching HirePulse tool, its price, the free-call balance and a ready-to-run request. Use when the right tool or expected cost is unclear; go directly to get_company_profile for a k

tools.name: x402_merchant_trust_check
tools.description: Pre-payment check of an x402 API endpoint: discovery files, live 402 terms, comparable USDC prices, latency, prompt-injection flags and public Coinbase CDP Bazaar payment statistics for the host. Heuristic, not a guarantee. $0.002; unreachable targets are free. Online shops: pre_purchase_merchant_tr

tools.name: url_to_clean_markdown
tools.description: Public web page to clean Markdown with title, meta description and a token estimate; scripts, navigation and ads removed. max_chars 1 to 100000 (default 15000). $0.002; empty results are free.

tools.name: pre_purchase_merchant_trust_check
tools.description: Public trust evidence for an unfamiliar online shop before buying: a cautious evidence score, risk flags, missing signals and limits. Cannot certify safety. $0.005 after the shared free calls. x402 API endpoints: x402_merchant_trust_check. Use for a consumer purchase from an unfamiliar shop; use b2b

tools.name: checkout_active_promo_code_finder
tools.description: Coupon code candidates published in the homepage metadata of a shop, with the source text. Codes are not verified at checkout. $0.01 per non-empty result. Use to collect possible discounts before checkout; use universal_product_url_to_json for product prices and availability. Does not apply coupons

tools.name: universal_product_url_to_json
tools.description: Product page to JSON: price, stock, variants, ratings and shipping evidence from JSON-LD, Microdata and OpenGraph, without a browser. Missing facts are null. $0.002 per result. Use for one product detail URL; use agentic_shelf_schema_comparator for a cross-store comparison or muse_agentic_store_read

tools.name: muse_agentic_store_readiness_auditor
tools.description: Store audit for shopping agents: machine-readable product data, UCP/ACP discovery, payment hints and robots.txt access, with a heuristic score and prioritized fixes. Not a certification or checkout test. $0.01 per result. Use to diagnose agent-readable store discovery and prioritize fixes; use unive

tools.name: muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder
tools.description: Store check for schema gaps, Google ad activity and public business contacts; a lead qualifies only with ad and SEO evidence. Public emails are not verified decision makers. $0.05 per qualified result. Use to qualify a known store for outreach about schema gaps; use muse_agentic_store_readiness_audi

tools.name: agentic_shelf_schema_comparator
tools.description: Compares a brand with up to 3 competitors as shopping schema: prices, ratings, availability, shipping and returns, from one sampled product per store. $0.02 per comparison. Use for a bounded cross-store comparison; use universal_product_url_to_json for one product or muse_agentic_store_readiness_aud

tools.name: verified_merchant_json_badge
tools.description: Signed public-evidence statement for a merchant domain, with expiry and a public verification key. It proves HirePulse issued the assessment, not ownership or purchase safety. $0.005 per result. Use when you need a portable signed assessment; use pre_purchase_merchant_trust_check for risk evidence w

tools.name: claim_free_trial
tools.description: Get a one-time trial pass: 25 free successful calls of any single tool, not tied to your IP, valid 30 days. Send exactly one of: a Base wallet that has activity, or a work email (no email is sent). Then pass the token as params._meta["hirepulse/trial_token"] or the X-Trial-Token header.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?profile=commerce&ref=registry-commerce" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, claim_free_trial · Private data: x402_merchant_trust_check, url_to_clean_markdown, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, claim_free_trial · Public sink: muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, claim_free_trial · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, muse_agentic_store_readiness_auditor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, claim_free_trial · Private data: x402_merchant_trust_check, url_to_clean_markdown, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, claim_free_trial · Public sink: muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, claim_free_trial · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, muse_agentic_store_readiness_auditor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
